_doc: Per-domain server endpoints baked into each fork's pre-provisioned account profile + the hub's 'open in app' fallbacks. Data-driven: change a host here, re-materialize the affected fork, get a rebuilt default config. All hosts terminate at the Caddy public edge (:443); mail uses SNI demux on :443 (NOT 993/465) per the public-surface-collapse design. NO secrets here — credentials flow through each fork's own login, never this file.

mail._doc: FairEmail fork pre-provisions an account against these. Implicit-TLS on :443 with SNI — Caddy L4 demuxes imap./smtps. to Maddy. JMAP host is Stalwart.

chat._doc: Mattermost fork locks its server URL to this. Push-proxy URL intentionally omitted until the push decision is made (see forks/chat/build.json::comment).

matrix._doc: Element X fork default homeserver. UnifiedPush distributor = our ntfy (rss.diegonmarcos.com). Values are placeholders pending the Matrix stack ship — confirm the real homeserver base URL + well-known at materialize time.
